description.p: Clonaut is a desktop interface for rclone: it starts its own local rclone daemon and drives it through the rclone REST API. rclone does all the work on your files; Clonaut is the cockpit.

ul.li: Create and manage remotes with a form generated from rclone's providers
Copy, move and sync with progress bars, speed and ETA
Honest dry runs that cannot write or delete anything
Safety trash for files that would be deleted or overwritten
Scheduled transfers that repeat every minutes, hours or days
Per-job exclusions and a system tray icon

description.p: The user interface is currently in Italian.
Clonaut è un'interfaccia desktop per rclone: avvia da sola un demone rclone locale e lo pilota tramite la sua REST API.

description.p: Security fixes from a penetration test: the rc password is kept off the command line in attach mode, only the rclone daemon started by Clonaut is trusted, messages from rclone are never shown as HTML, and settings, schedules and logs are readable by the owner only.
English interface (following the system language), AppImage for x86_64 and aarch64, AUR packages and a choice of which rclone to use.
Fixes: scheduled transfers no longer stop after closing the window, an unresponsive rclone daemon is reported, and a possible crash with PySide6 6.12 is gone.
First public release: edit scheduled transfers, Help → About, version in the window title, tray icon reacts to a single click, English README.
Renamed from «GUI rclone» to Clonaut, with many fixes.
